about: The owner's loaded words and what they PROVED to mean for a screen: each reading comes from a verdict (the vault's verdict page named in `evidence`) or a standing order. `kit ui direct new` finds these words in an ask and the brief must say how it reads each one (`reading`). Add an entry only from the owner's own words + a verdict; never invent one.

entries.reading: realistic = ABSENCE: report only what the player cannot feel or see; no arcade checklist (minimap, HP number, round count, crosshair, grey boxes); status only when it applies; markers in the world
'like <game>' = that game's REAL screens of the exact screen type, measured at 1:1 (kit ui refs + kit ui measure) before composing; its grammar, our own shapes
evidence: ui/verdicts/dmchud-v1--2026-10-10 (1/10: 'WHY DIDN'T U GRAB REFERENCES MAN LIKE THE UI WHEN U PLAY')

entries.reading: Persona is in the LETTERING: a face per glyph, mixed case, tilt, overlap, ink outline + a paper rim, a two-tone torn band; ransom for ONE word, a list is whole-word strips stepping right
a character or logo = the REAL official picture through the ink pipeline (kit ui ink), never a generated stand-in
evidence: ui/verdicts/arcade5title-v7--2026-10-11 (1/10: 'the image of heroine looks bad ... grab a proper picture')

entries.reading: 'cooler' = MOTION and a move taken from the source world (the smear card's v2 dash reel), not more decoration on the still
evidence: ui/verdicts/witchsmearcard--2026-10-13 ('WOW' on v1; v2 = the dash reel after 'nice but could be cooler')

entries.reading: alive = an animated reel of the real moments (a hit, the ghost drain, the low pulse) in the screen's own grammar, judged as a reel
evidence: ui/verdicts/arcade5health--2026-10-11 (9.2: 'AMAZING WORK SPLENDID' on the animated health bar + reel)

entries.reading: quality = change the MEDIUM (render, letter, ink, trace) built from measured real data; never polish a plateau, never typed glyphs + flat tints + rectangles
evidence: vault ui/orders: keep raising the quality - change the medium
graveyard: polishing with PIL past a plateau

entries.reading: original = its OWN visual language drawn from its own source world at the source's quality: the UI is an OBJECT of that world with its own verb and one signature moment only this game could have; never a genre swap, never the last success re-skinned; a big reinterpretation shows ONE test frame first
evidence: the owner 2026-10-24: 'take my bullshit prompting and turn it into something out of this world'

entries.reading: simple = fewer things on screen, each one RICH (the FieldHud compass: one thin line, in-world markers); never an empty flat panel - a 'dead space' panel reads as unfinished
evidence: preview gate: empty panel / dead space
